scientific_integrity: Exact pencil and root locus proved by Frobenius coefficient extraction, modular polynomial ODE and simple-root argument; finite independent arithmetic checks supplement but do not replace proof; closest previous work and residual historical risk disclosed.
scientific_limitations: All primes p congruent to 1 modulo 6, over algebraic closure; marked smooth coefficients only. No claim for other primes, minimal fields of roots, general Newton polygons or isomorphism-class count. A general older Shimura/Picard Hasse-invariant equivalent remains possible.
title: The reduced nonordinary divisor of bielliptic Picard curves for \(p\equiv1\pmod6\)
